# redBack.ai

> redBack.ai is an open-source, mobile-first AI ecosystem for spider species identification, arachnid taxonomy education, and citizen science observation tracking. Built with React Native / Expo SDK 54, Express.js / TypeScript Modern Modular Monolith, MongoDB, and Pinecone Vector Database.

## Core Capabilities

- **AI Vision & Pinecone Vector Search**: Dual-stage identification pipeline combining dense visual embeddings (CLIP/SigLIP) indexed in Pinecone Vector Database with Multimodal AI Vision Models for morphology verification, returning sub-50ms K-NN similarity rankings with visual evidence explanations.
- **Scientific Taxonomy & Biodiversity**: Curated arachnid database with Order, Family, Genus, Species hierarchy, habitat data, distribution maps, and conservation status.
- **Venom Safety & Medical Disclaimers**: Strict server-side safeguards. Mandatory legal/medical disclaimers on every identification payload. Prohibits emergency self-treatment advice; emphasizes immediate medical care for dangerous bites (*Latrodectus hasselti*, *Atrax robustus*).
- **Uncertainty Fallback Policy**: When combined confidence is below 70%, the system falls back to Genus or Family level (*Latrodectus sp.* / *Theridiidae*) and prompts the user for clearer photo angles.
- **Naturalist Field-Journal Design System**: Warm editorial UI with Serif display headings, crisp Sans-serif body, and authentic botanical palette (Coral `#E04836`, Forest Moss `#2C4A3E`, Canvas `#FBF9F4`, Slate Ink `#17211F`, Solar Gold `#E59824`).

## Technical Stack & Architecture

- **Mobile Client**: React Native 0.81, Expo SDK 54, Expo Router (file-based routing, 13 core screens), Lucide icons.
- **Backend Architecture**: Modern Modular Monolith in TypeScript with domain-driven bounded contexts (`src/modules/auth`, `src/modules/species`, `src/modules/identification`, `src/modules/learning`) and a shared kernel (`src/shared/`).
- **AI & Vector DB**: Pinecone Vector Database (Cosine similarity, metadata filtering by region/habitat) + Multimodal Vision Model.
- **Database & Storage**: MongoDB with Mongoose schemas + Cloud Object Storage for optimized spider photography.

## Developer Quickstart

```bash
# 1. Start local MongoDB
docker compose up -d

# 2. Run backend dev server (Modular Monolith)
cd backend && npm run dev

# 3. Run Expo mobile client
cd mobile && npx expo start
```
